LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.DebugInteractionWorkers: Enables debug logging for interaction workers when dev mode is active.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.CertaintyDriftRate.Tip: How fast a pawn's certainty moves toward its target each day. Higher = faith reacts faster to circumstances.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.RelationalMaxRange.Tip: The most that a pawn's opinion of their co-religionists can raise or lower their target certainty.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.PracticeMaxRange.Tip: The most that recent precept moods (rituals, veneration, taboos) can raise or lower their target certainty.
How far a single won argument moves the loser's belief on the topic, relative to default. Shifts both the precept and the conviction in that precept simultaneously. Higher = each won debate persuades more. Leads to more dynamic faiths.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConversionPace.Tip: How quickly pawns abandon a poorly-fitting faith on their own, relative to default. Higher = spontaneous conversions are more likely. Only affects passive conversion; debates and conversion attempts are unaffected.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConversionCertaintyKnoc: Certainty kept after a conversion attempt: {0}

When a moral guide wins a conversion debate but doesn't immediately flip the pawn, their certainty is multiplied by this - a temporary knock that leaves them more likely to switch, now and spontaneously afterwards. It climbs back toward their structural setpoint over time. 100% = no knock; 80% = an 80%-certain pawn drops to 64%. Lower = conversion attempts destabilize faith more.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConversionStancePull.Ti: How much harder a successful conversion attempt (a moral guide's directed action) pushes a pawn's beliefs than an ordinary debate win. It targets whichever belief most opposes the preacher's faith. At 1x a conversion is just a debate the preacher tries to win; higher = each successful attempt drags them further and converts faster. A failed attempt still shifts the preacher's own belief by the ordinary amount.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.CrisisThreshold.Tip: When a pawn's certainty falls below this, they may have a crisis-of-faith breakdown.
When loading a vanilla or pre-mod save, pawns whose certainty was below this have their beliefs seeded to at least this target instead of zero. Prevents a pawn at 0% certainty from being left with no conviction pull at all — they'll still be low-faith, but have somewhere to drift toward.
How strongly a pawn opposes the stance at the opposite extreme of an issue, as a fraction of their conviction. Opinion falls from full agreement at their own stance to this much opposition at the far end. 0 = indifferent to opposing stances; 100% = equal and opposite to their support for their own at the furthest extreme precept.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConvictionDecayRate.Tip: How much conviction strength all precepts lose per quadrum. 0 = no natural decay; 100% conviction is at a precept average of 20, max is 50.
LanguageData.EnhancedIdeology.ConversionOpinionMultip: How much a pawn's opinion of a moral guide amplifies a won conversion attempt. At 1x and opinion +100, both the certainty knock and the belief pull are doubled. At 0x, opinion has no effect. Not used when Peer Pressure is installed — that mod's own multiplier setting takes over instead.
